decision.rule: Among food-constrained cases passing G1 and G2, the default is the one with the lowest Earth census error already published (output/fertility_integration_20261106/earth_census.json, mean |log10(historical / capacity)| over the 11 census regions at the geometric midpoint of each historical range, recomputed from the published file at commit 9decd991: fert_bare 0.459, joint365 0.538, fert_legume 0.685; the report's earlier 0.407 / 0.682 predate the stand-residue fix and were corrected with this plan). If none passes, the default becomes legacy_0 and the supply cases stay as options.
